settings.alt: Wearing the white Summer Edition tee on a granite boulder above the treeline
settings.heading: Started by someone who'd rather be outside.
settings.text:
Peak Side began with a love of being outside and a long-held ambition to build a clothing brand.

Peak Side makes hoodies, tees and crop tops that work on a trail and still look right back in town. Mountains meet everyday.

settings.alt: A group of friends in Peak Side tees, crop tops and hoodies lined up in front of a graffiti tunnel
settings.heading: Built around the people who wear it.
settings.text: What started as one person's project has grown into a community of friends and customers who wear Peak Side on the trail, at school and everywhere in between.
